pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit irregular, sub-polygonal geometries with soft pixel gradients at the edges. Patch shapes on the mid-flank are more complex and stellate compared to the more compact, rounded patches on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous, high-thickness network of inter-patch pathways. Junction nodes are wide and non-acute, creating a consistent topological lattice across the visible torso and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a continuous, low-amplitude and high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck ridge. Individual hair bundles create a fine, repetitive jagged contour against the out-of-focus background.
